spec.title: Cooling delta (Indoor − Target)
spec.description: How far the room sits above the setpoint. >0 while cooling down, ~0 once reached. Persistently high can hint at an open window/door.

spec.title: Duty cycle (1h)
spec.description: Share of the last hour the unit was running.

spec.title: Runtime (24h)
spec.description: Approx. hours powered on in the last 24h (scrape-interval independent).

spec.title: Indoor
spec.description: Device internal sensor (coil-side) -- under-reports actual room temp.

spec.title: Target / Indoor / Outdoor
spec.description: Outdoor = device/exhaust-side sensor, NOT ambient outdoor air.
